issues.detail: The Hebrew text has only two names: הַלּוֹחֵ֥שׁ (Ha-Lochesh) and פִּלְחָ֖א (Pilcha), with שׁוֹבֵֽק (Shoveq) as a verb meaning 'leaves/abandons' (Qal participle of שׁבק). The Vietnamese renders three names, treating שׁוֹבֵֽק as a proper name 'Sô-béc', which is a mistranslation and adds a third name not present in the Hebrew.
